classification.difficultyReason: Apply the preceding graphical method to two new absolute-value functions, calculate their intersections and select the inclusive interval.

spec.description: Shared double-ended Cartesian axes without grid, ticks, numerical scale, origin label or supplied curves.
spec.mathematics: Drawing scaffold for y=|2x-1| and y=|x-3|.
spec.answerVisibility: Axes only; curves are student responses.

answer.worked:
Sketch $y=|2x-1|$ and $y=|x-3|$, with vertices $(\tfrac12,0)$ and $(3,0)$.

The intersecting branches give:
$$\begin{aligned}-(2x-1)&=-(x-3)\\-2x+1&=-x+3\\x&=-2\end{aligned}$$
$$\begin{aligned}2x-1&=-(x-3)\\3x&=4\\x&=\frac43\end{aligned}$$
The graph of $y=|2x-1|$ is on or below the graph of $y=|x-3|$ between these intersections. Hence $-2\le x\le \dfrac43$.
